args.name: ONE LAST TRY — Gaming Challenge Thumbnail

style.prompt: Create a bright, punchy, highly clickable 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. On the RIGHT half, a huge close-up face of an entirely invented adult gamer, expressive wide eyes, raised eyebrows, mouth open in genuine exaggerated shock, hands near cheeks, vibrant rim lighting, crisp expressive facial detail. On the LEFT half, the ONLY visible text is exactly these three words: "ONE LAST TRY", stacked in three huge lines, ONE / LAST / TRY, extremely bold condensed uppercase block letters, bright white and yellow with thick black outlines and strong dark drop shadows, perfectly readable at small thumbnail sizes. Keep all text inside the frame with generous safe margins. Background: energetic stylized video-game obstacle-course environment, glowing platforms, electric cyan and hot magenta light, fiery orange accents, speed streaks, dramatic high contrast, subtle background blur to keep focus on face and lettering. Professional thumbnail graphic design, clean simple composition, oversized visual hierarchy, polished cutout face with white outline, exciting tense final-attempt mood. No logos, no watermarks, no additional words, no real or recognizable person.
